headline: Force Motors schedules extraordinary general meeting for October 2026
summary: Force Motors Ltd has informed the stock exchange regarding a notice issued for an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled to be held on October 26, 2026. The company has not disclosed the specific agenda items or resolutions to be voted upon in this filing. Routine corporate governance meetings of listed entities do not typically cause immediate stock price volatility unless major restructuring is proposed. Retail shareholders should review the official meeting agenda once released by the company to understand potential governance impacts.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate filing with no immediate financial impact.
